evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/cache/a owns a shared 520-byte sector buffer, reads six-byte index entries and follows 520-byte data sectors with eight-byte headers plus up to 512 payload bytes.

The class owns separate RandomAccessFile data/index handles plus one store/archive id, validates file id/chunk/next-sector/store-id headers, and implements the paired read/write sector-chain operations.
Public 317 client Decompressor implementations use the same data/index RandomAccessFile pair, six-byte index records, 520-byte sectors, eight-byte sector headers and 512-byte payload chunks.
This class is the low-level cache store/sector reader-writer itself; the surrounding multi-index cache manager rs/cache/b is intentionally not named by this batch.

candidates.note: Original legacy 317 Decompressor identity recovered from the exact cache-sector format and RandomAccessFile structure.
